mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS declines > 100k
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS declines > 100k and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a shift towards service-oriented growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises > 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
